title: Professional Certificate Course in Strategic Vision and Mission of Corporate Culture
description: Explore the essence of corporate identity and direction in the Strategic Vision and Mission of Corporate Culture.
longDescription: Delve into the fundamental aspects of corporate identity and direction with this Strategic Vision and Mission of Corporate Culture course. Understand the significance of vision and mission statements, their differentiation, and their pivotal role in shaping organizational culture. Gain insights into the influence of leadership styles and organizational culture on crafting compelling visions and missions. Explore the concept of lateral thinking and the theories and barriers to innovation within the corporate context.
courseDetails: This course provides a comprehensive exploration of strategic vision and mission within the framework of corporate culture. Participants will learn about the definition and importance of vision and mission statements, discerning between the two, and their alignment with organizational values. Additionally, the course delves into the impact of leadership styles and organizational culture on shaping and communicating visions and missions effectively. Participants will also explore lateral thinking as a tool for innovation and the theories and barriers that affect innovative practices within organizations.
